$comment: Curated THINNR product catalog. Copy, taglines, ingredients, and facts are quoted verbatim from getthinnr.com product pages (retrieved 2026-08-22); only products actually on the site are listed. Product images were downloaded from those pages into assets/images/products/. Prices are demo values consistent with the staff operations dataset (getthinnr.com lists no public prices; products sell through licensed providers). The API server reads this file at runtime for coach grounding and product-card enforcement; topics are the intent keywords that make a product eligible for suggestion.
